C001.reason: The encoding side uses the producer's request.speed which is in m/s per intended_behavior. The new schema field is speed_kph (km/h). The generated TypeScript accessor will be speedKph. Must scale by 3.6 before encoding and use the new accessor name.

C002.reason: The observation reads entity.speedMps (old accessor). New schema has speed_kph with accessor speedKph. Must read the decoded value via speedKph, which is already in km/h per wire, and expose it under key speed_kph as per intended_behavior.

C003.reason: The speeding decision uses entity.speedMps > 30.0 (m/s threshold). New units are km/h; strict threshold becomes >108.0 km/h. Must compare the decoded km/h value (entity.speedKph) against 108.0.

edits.before: const sample = VehicleTelemetry.encode({ vehicleId: request.vehicle_id, speedMps: request.speed }).finish();
edits.after: const sample = VehicleTelemetry.encode({ vehicleId: request.vehicle_id, speedKph: request.speed * 3.6 }).finish();

edits.before: const fields = { vehicle_id: entity.vehicleId, speed_mps: entity.speedMps };
edits.after: const fields = { vehicle_id: entity.vehicleId, speed_kph: entity.speedKph };

edits.before: return { fields, speeding: entity.speedMps > 30.0, constructed_payload: Buffer.from(sample).toString("base64") };
edits.after: return { fields, speeding: entity.speedKph > 108.0, constructed_payload: Buffer.from(sample).toString("base64") };

rationale: All three required candidates involve the renamed field speed_mps -> speed_kph with unit change m/s -> km/h. Producer side (C001) scales request.speed (m/s) by 3.6 before encoding into speedKph. Consumer side (C002) reads decoded speedKph (km/h) and exposes as speed_kph. Decision side (C003) compares decoded km/h value against 108.0. Generated TypeScript accessors follow proto3 camelCase: speed_kph -> speedKph. Wire field 2 remains float32; decoded values are exposed as JSON numbers (double precision) per intended_behavior.
assumptions: Generated TypeScript bindings use camelCase accessors: speed_kph -> speedKph, vehicle_id -> vehicleId.
request.speed is in meters per second as stated in intended_behavior.
Coordinated rollout ensures all producers/consumers use new schema simultaneously.
No other files need changes; entity v1/v2 unchanged.
Float32 wire encoding/decoding preserves exact bit pattern; observations show decoded float32 as JSON numbers.
